facts.fact: La Nation reports that a future Startup Act is currently in preparation in Djibouti.

The Centre de Leadership et de l'Entrepreneuriat ran the Startup Djibouti programme, a first cohort of selected startups with mentoring, coaching and financial support, ending in a Demo Day; over 325 applications were received.
